snippet.title: Bad Grip Club | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope. Pull your friends up, use quirky items, and survive diverse biomes. Can your squad reach the top without falling down together?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4754860/Bad_Grip_Club/
